name: Secrets Manager
description: Sets, updates, or deletes an entry in the categorized secrets store used by other scripts via scripts/shared/secrets_store.py. The banner (before you click Run) shows what's already there via Secrets Viewer, so you can see existing entries and outstanding known integrations before making a change. Pick an entry from the dropdown - both existing ones (green check) and known-but-unset suggestions (circle) already carry their category/key, nothing else to fill in. Only use New Entry if you pick "+ CREATE NEW ENTRY" because neither fits. Values are stored plaintext under /app/data/secrets.json (chmod 600, same risk tier as a Docker environment block) and are never echoed back - only a character count confirms what was set.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: Pick one - this alone is enough for existing/suggested entries, no other field needed

parameters.name: new_entry
parameters.description: ONLY used when Entry above is "+ CREATE NEW ENTRY" - format category/KEY, e.g. finance/FINNHUB_API_KEY. Leave blank otherwise.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: New value (only used when action = Set / Update value)
